text:
julie: Heads up — cloud provider alerted us to patterns consistent with misuse of cross-account assume-role trust where ExternalId or Principal was set to wildcards. This could allow third parties to assume roles we intended to restrict. We need an immediate change to trust policies and a short rollout plan.

sec-bot: Automated scan results: 5 roles flagged in prod and 8 in non-prod. See list: prod-cross-account-audit-role, prod-cross-account-batch-runner, prod-cross-account-deploy; non-prod includes staging-*, ci-cross-* (full list in S3 report). Report: s3://redwood-sec/reports/cross-account-wildcard-1946000000.json

ben: on it. I'll prepare a tf patch to disallow "AWS": "*" and remove ExternalId="*" usages. Planning to push to infra branch, test in staging, then apply to prod canary.

lina: Quick Q — do we want to replace wildcard ExternalId with per-partner external IDs or move to an allowlist of account IDs + session policies?

julie: Priority: remove wildcard ExternalId immediately. For partner integrations we'll switch to partner-specific ExternalId or use external-account allowlist + session policy. Ben, target prod-cross-account-* first, then batch non-prod.

ben: Draft terraform snippet I'm going to apply (staging canary):

```
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "restrict_assume" {
  name = "restrict-assume"
  role = aws_iam_role.cross_account_role.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Deny",
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole",
        Resource = "*",
        Condition = {
          Null = { "aws:PrincipalAccount" = "false" }
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

ben: (will also update trust_block to use Principal = { AWS = ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"] } where applicable)

terry-oncall: I'll temporarily add an inline session restriction across accounts to block new sessions from roles with wildcards while we roll this out. That buys us ~2 hours to push changes.

eng-platform: Heads-up — any Terraform change touching iam roles needs a plan in infra-change-log and a short rollback strategy. We'll need a canary tag and a 30 minute monitoring window post-apply.

ben: Understood. Plan:
- 0m: Add session-block rule (terry) to block new assume-role sessions for flagged roles.
- 10m: Apply TF change in staging for prod-cross-account-audit-role (canary).
- +30m: Monitor logs for auth failures. If OK, apply remaining prod-cross-account-* roles.
- +2h: Apply non-prod patch groups.

lina: Can sec-bot update the list to include the exact role ARNs and owners? Need to message partners for ExternalId changes.

sec-bot: Updated: flagged_role_arns = ["arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/prod-cross-account-audit-role", "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/prod-cross-account-batch-runner", "arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/prod-cross-account-deploy", ...] — owners mapped in the report. Link: s3://redwood-sec/reports/cross-account-wildcard-1946000000.json

julie: Owners — please confirm on this thread once you've applied the change to your role(s). Required by EOD today. If you need partner coordination, mark the ticket P0 and loop in solutions-eng.

ben: Confirmed — starting now, will post status updates.

terry-oncall: Session-block applied. Monitoring for errors.

lina: Kicking off partner outreach for the three external teams. Will cc security and platform.

ben: prod-canary applied to prod-cross-account-audit-role at 1946000120; no auth regressions in 20m. Proceeding with remaining prod roles.

julie: Thanks team. After rollout, let's run a full inventory for wildcard conditions across all trust policies and add an automated guard in PR checks to refuse ExternalId="*" or Principal="*".

eng-platform: Will add a pre-merge check to terraform-validate pipeline by tomorrow morning.

sec-bot: NOTE: follow-up alert scheduled in 6h to re-scan and confirm no wildcard conditions remain.

ben: All prod flagged roles patched at 1946000300. Starting non-prod batch.

julie: Great work. Short retro tomorrow to capture process and update runbooks. :clap:
